skills.summary: Move `await` operations into the branches where they're actually used to avoid blocking code paths that don't need them.

skills.title: Dependency-Based Parallelization
skills.summary: For operations with partial dependencies, use `better-all` to maximize parallelism. It automatically starts each task at the earliest possible moment.

skills.title: Promise.all() for Independent Operations
skills.summary: When async operations have no interdependencies, execute them concurrently using `Promise.all()`.

skills.title: Strategic Suspense Boundaries
skills.summary: Instead of awaiting data in async components before returning JSX, use Suspense boundaries to show the wrapper UI faster while data loads.

skills.title: Avoid Barrel File Imports
skills.summary: Import directly from source files instead of barrel files to avoid loading thousands of unused modules. **Barrel files** are entry points that re-export multiple modules (e.g., `index.js` that does `e...

skills.title: Conditional Module Loading
skills.summary: Load large data or modules only when a feature is activated.

skills.title: Defer Non-Critical Third-Party Libraries
skills.summary: Analytics, logging, and error tracking don't block user interaction. Load them after hydration.

skills.title: Dynamic Imports for Heavy Components
skills.summary: Use `next/dynamic` to lazy-load large components not needed on initial render.

skills.title: Preload Based on User Intent
skills.summary: Preload heavy bundles before they're needed to reduce perceived latency.

skills.title: Deduplicate Global Event Listeners
skills.summary: Use `useSWRSubscription()` to share global event listeners across component instances.

skills.title: Use SWR for Automatic Deduplication
skills.summary: SWR enables request deduplication, caching, and revalidation across component instances.

skills.title: Batch DOM CSS Changes
skills.summary: Avoid changing styles one property at a time. Group multiple CSS changes together via classes or `cssText` to minimize browser reflows.

skills.title: Cache Repeated Function Calls
skills.summary: Use a module-level Map to cache function results when the same function is called repeatedly with the same inputs during render.

skills.title: Cache Property Access in Loops
skills.summary: Cache object property lookups in hot paths.

skills.title: Cache Storage API Calls
skills.summary: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, and `document.cookie` are synchronous and expensive. Cache reads in memory.

skills.title: Combine Multiple Array Iterations
skills.summary: Multiple `.filter()` or `.map()` calls iterate the array multiple times. Combine into one loop.

skills.title: Early Return from Functions
skills.summary: Return early when result is determined to skip unnecessary processing.

skills.title: Hoist RegExp Creation
skills.summary: Don't create RegExp inside render. Hoist to module scope or memoize with `useMemo()`.

skills.title: Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups
skills.summary: Multiple `.find()` calls by the same key should use a Map.

skills.title: Early Length Check for Array Comparisons
skills.summary: When comparing arrays with expensive operations (sorting, deep equality, serialization), check lengths first. If lengths differ, the arrays cannot be equal.

skills.title: Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort
skills.summary: Finding the smallest or largest element only requires a single pass through the array. Sorting is wasteful and slower.

skills.title: Use Set/Map for O(1) Lookups
skills.summary: Convert arrays to Set/Map for repeated membership checks.

skills.title: Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability
skills.summary: `.sort()` mutates the array in place, which can cause bugs with React state and props. Use `.toSorted()` to create a new sorted array without mutation.

skills.title: Use Activity Component for Show/Hide
skills.summary: Use React's `<Activity>` to preserve state/DOM for expensive components that frequently toggle visibility.

skills.title: Animate SVG Wrapper Instead of SVG Element
skills.summary: Many browsers don't have hardware acceleration for CSS3 animations on SVG elements. Wrap SVG in a `<div>` and animate the wrapper instead.

skills.title: Use Explicit Conditional Rendering
skills.summary: Use explicit ternary operators (`? :`) instead of `&&` for conditional rendering when the condition can be `0`, `NaN`, or other falsy values that render.

skills.title: CSS content-visibility for Long Lists
skills.summary: Apply `content-visibility: auto` to defer off-screen rendering.

skills.title: Hoist Static JSX Elements
skills.summary: Extract static JSX outside components to avoid re-creation.

skills.title: Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering
skills.summary: When rendering content that depends on client-side storage (localStorage, cookies), avoid both SSR breakage and post-hydration flickering by injecting a synchronous script that updates the DOM before ...

skills.title: Optimize SVG Precision
skills.summary: Reduce SVG coordinate precision to decrease file size. The optimal precision depends on the viewBox size, but in general reducing precision should be considered.

skills.title: Defer State Reads to Usage Point
skills.summary: Don't subscribe to dynamic state (searchParams, localStorage) if you only read it inside callbacks.

skills.title: Subscribe to Derived State
skills.summary: Subscribe to derived boolean state instead of continuous values to reduce re-render frequency.

skills.title: Use Functional setState Updates
skills.summary: When updating state based on the current state value, use the functional update form of setState instead of directly referencing the state variable. This prevents stale closures, eliminates unnecessar...

skills.title: Use Lazy State Initialization
skills.summary: Pass a function to `useState` for expensive initial values. Without the function form, the initializer runs on every render even though the value is only used once.

skills.title: Extract to Memoized Components
skills.summary: Extract expensive work into memoized components to enable early returns before computation.

skills.title: Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates
skills.summary: Mark frequent, non-urgent state updates as transitions to maintain UI responsiveness.

skills.title: Cross-Request LRU Caching
skills.summary: `React.cache()` only works within one request. For data shared across sequential requests (user clicks button A then button B), use an LRU cache.

skills.title: Per-Request Deduplication with React.cache()
skills.summary: Use `React.cache()` for server-side request deduplication. Authentication and database queries benefit most.

skills.title: Parallel Data Fetching with Component Composition
skills.summary: React Server Components execute sequentially within a tree. Restructure with composition to parallelize data fetching.
